title: Shared contract definitions
description: Vocabulary shared by the series, Trend, Discovery and catalog contracts. Terms are defined in CONTEXT.md.

regionId.description: Identifier of a Region. The Region catalog is the authority on which ids exist.

variableId.description: Identifier of a Variable. The Variable catalog is the authority on which ids exist.

period.description: Month range, inclusive at both ends.

engineVersion.description: Version of the engine that produced the result. Stored results are keyed by it.

source.description: Where the data came from. Shown to students under "How do we know?".

provider.description: Archive or service, e.g. GES DISC or AppEEARS.

variable.description: Variable name within the product, e.g. Tair_f_inst.

seriesRef.description: Points at one Region-Variable series without carrying its values.

selectedArea.description: A Selected area (#79): one or more rectangles that touch or overlap, each [west, south, east, north] in degrees. A rectangle with west > east crosses the antimeridian. A grid cell belongs to the area when its centre lies in any rectangle. A Selected area is never a Region.

notice.description: Set when live acquisition fails and preloaded examples are served (BS-009). Ordinary cache hits use provenance without this failure notice.
